WILDER WORLD COMMUNITY GUIDELINES   

 Welcome to Wilder World, where our community and the Wilder Spirit form the essence of our movement. Being a Wilder means committing to trust, humility, and kindness. By embracing these values, you'll awaken the Wilder Spirit within. 

  As part of our global community, we respect one another, take responsibility for our actions, and bring positive vibes to every interaction. The Wilders rise together as one!

 To ensure a positive experience for everyone, all Wilders are encouraged to operate in good faith and adhere to the following guidelines:

 No scamming, spamming, fudding or phishing - unsolicited direct spam messages with random links is not the Wilder way. Please respect your fellow community members.

 We encourage all Wilders to share their life experiences with the community, but requesting money or financial assistance is prohibited. Please do not request donations or solicit any form of financial help from any community members. This guideline is in place to prevent potential solicitation scams.

 We have zero tolerance for sexism, racism, ageism, hate speech, discrimination, and posting of explicit or graphically disturbing content.

 Verbal abuse, personal attacks or targeted harassment towards other Wilders or Wilder Team members will not be tolerated. Shaming, blaming and destructive behaviour included. 

 Sharing someone’s personal information, private messages (such as DM screenshots), or doxing of any kind without their consent is strictly prohibited. Respecting each other’s privacy is a core part of the Wilder way.

 Politics and religion are delicate conversations to have in a public space. Be respectful of your fellow Wilder Citizens when discussing these topics and be aware that you are part of a global community. 

 While we celebrate Wilders developing their own projects, shilling is not permitted in our Discord server to maintain a focused community environment.

 Wilders should refrain from encouraging negative or harmful actions towards others. Love, peace and harmony is our motto.

 Please show respect for Wilder World Team members. They are here to help guide you and keep things in good flow. If they ask you to stop doing something, we promise, it’s for the greater good of our community. 

 Constructive feedback is welcome, but persistent negativity, fear-mongering or fudding is not in the Wilder Spirit and will be addressed if it begins to disrupt the harmony of our community.

 Please treat everyone with respect and kindness, especially new Wilders. We are here to guide them in the way of the Wilder Spirit. First impressions can have a lasting effect on someone.

 Blessings and Love,
Team Wilder
